title: SDA: Steering-Driven Distribution Alignment for Open LLMs without Fine-Tuning
benchmark_measurement: The paper's benchmarks do not measure any aspects of faith or religion. They measure helpfulness (including empathy and reasoning), harmlessness, and honesty (reliability).
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
